name: ADAC Cyclassics
story: A six-rider breakaway established an early lead before attacks from Benoît Cosnefroy and Isaac Del Toro intensified the race over the repeated Waseberg climbs. Del Toro’s final acceleration split the peloton and eliminated several leading sprinters, but no move stayed clear. Paul Magnier then won the reduced-group sprint ahead of Mike Teunissen and Laurence Pithie.
